english.title: Operator of applicable helicopter fail to preserve recording made by combined cockpit voice / flight data recorder
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a helicopter required to carry a combined cockpit voice recorder and flight data recorder specified in paragraph (3) of Scale SS of paragraph 5 of Part 1 of Schedule 6 to the Air Navigation Order 2016, failed to, at all times, preserve either the last eight hours of recording made by the combined cockpit voice recorder and flight data recorder or the recording specified in article 234(3) of the Order
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 234 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the operator of a helicopter required to carry a combined cockpit voice recorder and flight data recorder specified in paragraph (3) of Scale SS of paragraph 5 of Part 1 of Schedule 6 to the Air Navigation Order 2016, failed to, at all times, preserve either the last eight hours of recording made by the combined cockpit voice recorder and flight data recorder or the recording specified in article 234(3) of the Order.
